name: os-internals-expert
description: Specialist in operating-systems fundamentals and internals based on OSTEP (Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces, Arpaci-Dusseau): processes and LDE, scheduling (FIFO/SJF/STCF/RR/MLFQ/lottery/stride/CFS), virtual memory (base/bounds, segmentation, paging, TLB, swap, page replacement), concurrency (locks, condition variables, semaphores, deadlock), persistence (HDD, RAID, vsfs, FFS, journaling, LFS, SSD/FTL, checksums) and NFS/AFS. Includes index lookup, deterministic simulators and calculators, with automatic citation verification.
